description: Conversion of existing garage and storage building into changing rooms including replacement rendering with brickwork and new fenestration details, replacement existing boundary fencing with 2.5m high mesh perimeter fence.  Demolition of two detached garage structures and extension of the existing access ramp including new safety hand railing. Other works to include installation of no3 roof mounted extractor fans, new gate to car-park, and widening of the existing dropped curb.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
